recognize_zh: 未染色的頭髮光學顯微鏡檢查：髮幹內的黑色素不是均勻細緻分布，而是聚成一段段深褐色、大小不一的團塊沿髮幹排列；配合巨大顆粒的白血球，就是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的毛髮表現。
features: Unstained hair shafts examined by light microscopy with mounting-medium air bubbles
Melanin aggregated into discrete dark brown clumps along the shaft rather than finely dispersed
Clumps are irregular in size and spacing, predominantly along the central shaft
Hair shaft cuticle and cortex otherwise intact without fractures or nodes
describe_en: Light microscopy of unstained hair shafts shows abnormal aggregation of melanin into discrete dark brown clumps distributed along the length of the shafts, in contrast to the fine uniform pigment of normal hair. The clumps vary in size and spacing. The shafts are otherwise structurally intact, without trichorrhexis or other shaft defects. In a patient with giant granules in leukocytes, the findings are consistent with the pigmentary defect of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Griscelli syndrome shows larger, more irregular and unevenly spaced melanin clumps and lacks giant granules in leukocytes.
Elejalde syndrome has similar large pigment clumps but with neurologic disease and no giant leukocyte granules.
Normal hair has fine, evenly dispersed melanin granules without discrete clumps.
